place: IU Health North Hospital, Roof Garden

conventions.world_to_camera: 4x4 OpenCV extrinsic (camera x right, y down, z forward) mapping COLMAP world points to camera: p_cam = world_to_camera @ p_world. qvec_wxyz/tvec are the same pose in COLMAP images.txt convention.
conventions.enu: Local east-north-up frame in metres: x = east, y = north, z = up, origin at (latitude, longitude), z ~ 0 at ground level. The satellite raster is centred on the same (latitude, longitude).
conventions.colmap_to_enu: 4x4 similarity: p_enu = colmap_to_enu @ p_colmap (homogeneous). The 3x3 block is scale_colmap_to_metres * R (not orthonormal). For DL3DV the axis change (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y) that precedes the published transform is already folded in.
conventions.camera_to_world_enu: 4x4 metric SE(3) camera-to-world pose in the ENU frame with orthonormal rotation, i.e. colmap_to_enu @ inv(world_to_camera) with the scale divided out of the rotation block.
conventions.frame_index: Position of the frame in the sorted frame list below; benchmark_splits refer to these indices.
